subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should configured model costs stay USD-only, or should OpenClaw add a non-USD currency contract for model pricing and cost display?
rationale: This changes a public config surface and accounting semantics across UI, CLI/status, persisted session fields, docs, and telemetry, so automation should not choose the contract shape.

options.title: Design one currency contract first
options.body: Choose the scope, ISO-code behavior, mixed-currency aggregation rules, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Continue treating configured model pricing as USD estimates and leave provider-reported balances as the only multi-currency surface.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol override while explicitly keeping stored values and telemetry USD-like, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Design one currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope, ISO-code behavior, mixed-currency aggregation rules, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on usage cost formatting, provider billing display, and cost-analysis UI.
